requirements.requirement: Original sampled speed throughout qualifying operation against the 80 mph absolute ceiling
requirements.source: NRS 484B.600(1)(e); It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: In any event, a rate of speed greater than 80 miles per hour.

requirements.requirement: Qualifying driver, vehicle and highway context
requirements.source: the subject drives or operates a vehicle of any kind on any highway
